selection_rationale: Battlecruisers give the cheapest spinal coiler and armor per point at 1.5g. Cheap frigates add PD turrets and screening against torpedo waves. The fleet fights as one mass and closes to short range where gun accuracy is high.
formation_rationale: Tight arc within ~60 km lateral keeps all ships in overlapping PD range. Battlecruisers form a forward-bowed line to absorb the first exchange, with frigates tucked behind for PD cover and protection from gun fire.
